review_scope: source_by_bucket_starts_empty (phase0:1207): fresh dict is BucketCacheOk for any round (BucketCacheOk_nil from lot 53).
each_round_starts_empty: both rounds r and r' get a well-formed empty cache — trivial conjunction of _nil for two rounds.
BucketCacheOk_singleton: a singleton [(bucket, hash preimage)] is well-formed under a round r. Uses List.mem_singleton.mp on the sole member to give the round r's preimage hash.

BucketCacheOk_two_rounds_hash_eq: if a cache is well-formed at BOTH rounds r and r' AND (bucket, src) ∈ cache, then hash preimage_r = hash preimage_r' — because both hokr and hokr' agree on src. This proves that transferring the dict across rounds requires a hash equality (which is not free under a hash that distinguishes rounds).
BucketCacheOk_fresh_not_other_round: a singleton filled at round r is not well-formed at round r' when hash(preimage_r) ≠ hash(preimage_r'). Direct contradiction from applying hok to the member.

BucketCacheOk_echo_round_0_not_1: instance under echoHeadHash — the round-0 fill is well-formed at round 0 (BucketCacheOk_singleton) but NOT at round 1 (uses BucketCacheOk_fresh_not_other_round + sourceByBucket_round_ne_echo from lot 56).

sourceCacheStep_stale_round_hit: reusing the round-0 dict at round 1 returns the stale round-0 digest — sourceCacheStep_hit from lot 53 applies (there's a hit at bucket 0 in the transferred dict), and the digest disagrees with the fresh round-1 digest.
Three new #print axioms mutants: shuffle_cache_starts_empty_each_round, shuffle_cache_not_reused_across_rounds, shuffle_stale_cache_hit_is_wrong_round — each wraps an extraction lemma.
OPEN scope preserved: SHA256 pivot and swap-bit VALUES still uninterpreted. This lot proves the phase0:1207 invariant that the dict is round-local — reusing it across rounds returns stale digests.
